items.label: Cisco Q4 FY2026 (08-12-2026)
items.reason: Archiving the condensed transcripts/systems/cisco_q4_2026.txt (board 2026-10-19) leaves the verbatim call, which renders the Acacia unit counts as '850,400 gig' / '75,800 gig'; the figure keeps only numbers the call states and the signal quotes the call's wording.
items.evidence: And to date, we have shipped over 850,400 gig and over 75,800 gig coherent pluggable optics.

set.signal: SCALE-ACROSS is the emerging motion: CEO Chuck Robbins: 'we think the network traffic related to AI-based scale-across versus traditional data center interconnect is roughly 14x what it might have been before.' Three new hyperscaler design wins in Q4 — (1) a Silicon One P200-powered system for SCALE-ACROSS, the third P200 scale-across win since launch, EACH WITH A SEPARATE HYPERSCALER, with orders already received from all three in Q4; (2) a G200-powered system for scale-out; and (3) a MANAGED OPTICAL FIBER NETWORK win using Cisco's line-system technology that enables its digital coherent optics inside THIRD-PARTY equipment — strategically positioning Cisco as an alternative to an incumbent competitor. Cisco has line of sight to multiple further AI design wins over the next six months across G300, G200 and P200 silicon plus optics, and MULTI-RAIL OPTICAL SYSTEMS are 'coming soon' / beginning to deploy. Acacia took over $1B of orders in Q4 and, in the transcript's words, has 'shipped over 850,400 gig and over 75,800 gig coherent pluggable optics' to date (read: over 850,000 400G and over 75,000 800G units).
set.figure: scale-across traffic ~14x DCI; 3rd P200 scale-across win (3 separate hyperscalers, all ordering); Acacia >$1B Q4 orders
